lyrics:
[Spoken word]
ଗାଁର ନିର୍ଜନ ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମ,
ବରଷୁଥିବା ବୁନ୍ଦାର ଛାଇ,
ରେଳଧାରଣାରେ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ
ଚାଲିଯାଉଥିବା ଟ୍ରେନ୍‌ର ଥରଥର ଧ୍ୱନି।
ଆଜି ପୁଣି ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନରେ
ଯେଉଁଠି ତୁମେ ଛାଡ଼ିଯାଇଥିଲ,
ଆଉ ଏବେ ବି ଅପେକ୍ଷାରେ ଅଛି,
ତୁମେ କେବେ ଫେରିଆସିବ ବୋଲି...।
[End]
title: KBL · କ୍ଷଣିକା · Male voice, quiet music
style: Spoken-word ballad, deep male Odia voice with natural pronunciation, slow soulful narration and expressive emotional pauses. Voice intimate, clear and prominently foregrounded. Very soft, sparse piano chords and barely audible ambient pads underneath; occasional gentle flute between spoken phrases, delicate distant string swells, almost imperceptible percussion. Spacious cinematic reverb on the accompaniment, lighter reverb on the voice to preserve clarity. A subtle 70 BPM pulse supports free, natural speech. Restrained gradual build; accompaniment stays quiet throughout and gently recedes whenever the narrator speaks. Preserve every word without repetition or added lyrics.
exclude: EDM, heavy dance beats, aggressive percussion, loud backing music, dense orchestration, overpowering bass, dramatic drops, theatrical belting, excessive vocal runs, melodic singing, chanting, rap, choir, backing vocals, vocoder, autotune effects, chopped vocals, heavy vocal echo
rationale: User supplied and preferred soulful male spoken-word ballad direction, then requested quieter music. Preserve that requested atmosphere, using the exact revised prompt and exclusions. New text-based take, not a remix claiming to preserve a previous performance.
